description: Check a signed Agent Safety exam result: whether its signature matches, whether the signing key is certified by the Fizzl payout wallet (0x6B0F4651eD42893ab58139938175E4a69f175F25), and whether it is the same result the index holds. Give the result itself (as an agent showed it to you) or its result_id. Free.

result.description: Or a whole signed result (with signer and signature), as an agent or a website showed it

result_id.description: A result id (24 hex characters), to check the result in the index

name: agent_safety_verify

certified.description: The key is certified by the Fizzl payout wallet for this result's date

current_signer.description: The key is the exam's key today

in_index.description: The same result as the index holds under its id (null: the index has none)

signer.description: The address that signed the result

valid.description: true: the signature matches and the key is the exam's (certified by the Fizzl payout wallet, or its current key)

title: Is this exam result real?
